claims.text: The excerpted termination section lets either Party terminate only on listed grounds, starting with the phrase 'Either Party may terminate this Agreement:'. The listed grounds are non-payment after a 30-day notice period, and material breach that is not cured within the cure period. Neither excerpt describes a right to terminate without cause or for convenience.

citations.quote: Either Party may terminate this Agreement:
if the other Party breaches any material term or condition of this Agreement

claims.text: The excerpts show a termination right for Reseller tied to the Annual Minimum Commitment (AMC) and sales targets. This is conditional on the sales targets not being met, so it is not a general convenience right.

citations.quote: if Reseller terminates the provisions of the Annual Minimum Commitment
fails to meet the sales targets as set out in Schedule 3

claims.text: The only other exit shown for Reseller is non-renewal. Reseller may terminate by giving notice within sixty days before the end of the Initial Term or any renewal term. This is a renewal decision, not a termination for convenience during the term.

citations.quote: unless terminated by Reseller within sixty (60) days prior to the expiration of the Initial Term or any renewal term

claims.text: Automatic termination under subsection (b) is triggered by events such as Reseller ceasing its business or a winding-up, dissolution or liquidation. These are not convenience terminations. The excerpt of subsection (b) is cut off, so the full list of automatic-termination events is not visible in the sources.

citations.quote: Reseller ceases carrying on its business
winding-up, dissolution or liquidation of Reseller
